metadata.disclaimer: This is a demonstration feed showing RegTrack's real-time regulatory monitoring capability. All updates reference actual regulatory developments.

updates.title: GAID 2025 Now Effective: New Compliance Obligations for DCPMIs
updates.summary: The General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025 is now in effect. It operationalizes the NDP Act 2023 with detailed requirements for DCPMI registration, compliance audit returns, data protection impact assessments, and breach notification procedures.
compliance_actions: Review DCPMI classification thresholds (UHL: >10,000 data subjects or sensitive data)
Prepare for annual Compliance Audit Returns filing by March 31st
Engage licensed DPCO for compliance audit certification
Update breach response procedures per GAID specifications

updates.title: NDP Act 2023 - Full Legal Framework for Nigerian Data Protection
updates.summary: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 establishes the legal framework for data protection in Nigeria, creating the NDPC as the independent regulatory authority. Key provisions include lawful basis for processing, consent requirements, data subject rights, DPO appointment, breach notification, and DCPMI registration.
compliance_actions: Understand lawful bases for processing (Section 25)
Implement consent mechanisms meeting Section 26 requirements
Publish privacy policy per Section 27
Determine DCPMI status and registration requirements
Establish 72-hour breach notification procedures

updates.title: CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022 - Full Implementation Required
updates.summary: The CBN AML/CFT Regulations for Banks and Other Financial Institutions in Nigeria, 2022, require enhanced customer due diligence, suspicious transaction reporting to NFIU within 24 hours, enterprise-wide risk assessments, and independent compliance audits.
compliance_actions: Implement Customer Due Diligence with BVN/NIN verification
Establish 24-hour STR reporting to NFIU
Conduct enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk assessment
Appoint designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer
Maintain transaction records for minimum 5 years

updates.title: CBN Consumer Protection Regulations 2019 - Data Privacy Requirements
updates.summary: Financial service providers must protect consumer privacy, not disclose information without consent, implement data security measures, and comply with Nigeria Data Protection Regulation.
compliance_actions: Protect consumer data privacy and confidentiality
Obtain express consent before sharing consumer data
Implement appropriate data security measures

updates.title: SEC Crowdfunding Rules 2021 - Registration Requirements
updates.summary: Crowdfunding portals must register with SEC, maintain minimum N100 million capital, implement investor protection measures, and conduct due diligence on issuers.
compliance_actions: Register crowdfunding portal with SEC
Maintain minimum N100 million capital
Implement risk disclosure and 48-hour cooling-off period
Conduct issuer due diligence

updates.title: NITDA Data Protection Implementation Framework
updates.summary: Organizations processing data of 1000+ individuals must appoint DPO, conduct annual DPIAs, publish privacy policy, maintain data inventory, and implement breach notification procedures.
compliance_actions: Appoint Data Protection Officer if processing 1000+ data subjects
Conduct annual Data Protection Impact Assessments
Publish privacy policy on website
Report breaches to NITDA within 72 hours

updates.title: NITDA Guidelines for Nigerian Content Development in ICT
updates.summary: Guidelines promoting local content in ICT sector, requiring preference for Nigerian-made software, hardware, and services in government procurement and private sector.
compliance_actions: Review software procurement policies for local content compliance
Register Nigerian-developed solutions with NITDA

updates.title: NDPC Guidance on AI and Automated Decision-Making Under Development
updates.summary: NDPC is developing comprehensive guidance on Section 37 of the NDP Act 2023 regarding automated decision-making and AI systems. The guidance will address transparency, human intervention, and explainability requirements.
compliance_actions: Monitor NDPC website for published AI guidance
Document current AI decision-making processes
Prepare to implement human review options for automated decisions
